_about: Second paragraph of each home's text (the first is short_description in properties.json), written from the agency listing and in the site's plain tone. Facts only from the listing; French words are kept where the listing uses them (the glossary explains them). Nothing is generated from the record any more.

paragraphs.pepieux-stone-house-1962:
It keeps its original features: a water pump, exposed beams and decorative roof tiles, and has been tastefully refitted with a French country feel.
A large living room with a fully equipped kitchen opens onto the living space. There are two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two more rooms, one used as a spare bedroom. A low-maintenance second home or holiday rental. Olonzac is about 4 km away on the map, Carcassonne 29 km, Narbonne 33 km and Carcassonne airport 32 km.
paragraphs.le-vigeant-village-house-a37509:
Downstairs, the living room opens into a light-filled kitchen and dining room with views over the private courtyard. Upstairs are two bedrooms and a bathroom, and the front bedroom is especially large.
An attached stone outbuilding (a dépendance) leads to the courtyard, and stone steps climb to the garden. Three restaurants and bars are within walking distance, with the riverside attractions close by.
paragraphs.merdrignac-stone-cottage-newton: The property measures 120 m², with 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, on a plot of 265 m². Listed features: stone, terrace, garden. Located in Merdrignac, Brittany.
paragraphs.lacaze-timbered-house-60636342:
This colombage stands in Lacaze, a Petite Cité de Caractère in the Tarn. It has three levels and a dry cellar: a large open ground floor for a workshop, shop or gallery, a refreshed first floor and three rooms to refresh above. Each floor has its own landing, so it could become one flat per level. A rare 16th–17th century roof frame, a pellet stove and two open fireplaces.
The village has a château, a museum, a gîte, a restaurant, a grocery, a post office and a bus. Toulouse is 1 hour 30 away, Albi and Castres 45 minutes.
paragraphs.champgeneteux-renovation-a44098: The peaceful spot feels private. The main house can be lived in today, with a simple, practical layout, and would benefit from modernising throughout, which leaves room to add value. The plot has outbuildings and a garden, the house has a wood burner, and the agent sees potential for a gîte. Mayenne is about 19 km away on the map and Laval about 40 km.
paragraphs.pressignac-stone-cottage-a41100:
Downstairs are a large lounge and dining room, a fitted kitchen and a utility room; upstairs, two bedrooms and a bathroom. There is a small garden, an adjoining barn and a garage.
The village has a restaurant, a post office, a bread depot and a grocery with local produce. Rochechouart and Chabanais, with full amenities, are under 9 km away, lakes for swimming and sailing under 5 km, and Limoges airport 45 km.
paragraphs.la-chapelle-montbrandeix-stone-house-a29: The house is on the edge of the Dordogne and has the charm of a cottage. It is in good condition, with a garage and a large outbuilding (a dépendance). Villages with all amenities, and historic monuments, are a few kilometres away.
paragraphs.thollet-farmhouse-bvi72280:
This longère, a long low farmhouse, has a well-equipped kitchen that opens onto the garden, a lounge, three bedrooms and a study, a bathroom with a shower and a bath, and a separate toilet. A large attic could become more living space, with permission.
The garden has a terrace with a barbecue and covered seating. Poitiers and Limoges airport are easy to reach.
paragraphs.saint-sebastien-cottage-a45393: The village has some amenities. The cottage is in good condition, with three bedrooms, a wood burner, private parking and mains drainage. La Souterraine is about 18 km away on the map, Guéret 36 km and Limoges airport 65 km.
paragraphs.locarn-country-house-a45191:
Downstairs are a spacious fitted kitchen with a dining area, a cosy lounge with a log burner, a bathroom and a separate toilet. Upstairs are two double bedrooms and a landing with room for a home office, and one bedroom opens onto the balcony.
The attached garage leads to a small workshop and wood store, and to the low-maintenance garden at the back. Double glazing throughout. Rostrenen and Carhaix-Plouguer are about 13 km away on the map, Guingamp 33 km and Lannion airport 49 km.
paragraphs.saint-ouen-la-thene-house-a39000:
The hamlet is 3 km from the large village of Beauvais-sur-Matha, which has shops; Matha is 12 km away, Cognac 25 km and the Atlantic beaches about an hour by car. The owners have looked after the house well: double glazing, modern electrics and central heating.
A large living room has a wood burner. A workshop could become a ground-floor bedroom, and a separate top floor has a bedroom with its own shower room and a dressing room. The fosse septique (the private septic tank) will need updating. Sold furnished.
paragraphs.saint-germain-de-confolens-house-a44033:
The living space is on three floors and keeps its period features, behind a front that dates from the 17th or 18th century. From the house you look towards the ruins of the Château de Saint-Germain-de-Confolens.
Confolens is minutes away, St Junien and Bellac less than an hour, Limoges airport 55 km and Poitiers 72 km. It could be a home, a holiday home or a gîte.
paragraphs.exideuil-village-house-a44580: The property measures 189 m², with 5 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, on a plot of 669 m². Listed features: garden, outbuildings. Located in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine.
paragraphs.azillanet-stone-house-a44962: The ground floor has a kitchen and dining room and a utility room; above are a living room, a spacious shower room, a bedroom and a study. The sun terrace looks over the Corbières, the foothills of the Montagne Noire, the Pyrenees and the terracotta roofs of the village. Olonzac is about 4 km away on the map, Narbonne 31 km, Béziers 40 km and Carcassonne airport 37 km.
paragraphs.gourdon-stone-house-a43147:
The hamlet is 4 km from the shops of Gourdon. Inside are exposed beams and stone, fireplaces and a mullioned window with a window seat. The ground floor has a large kitchen and dining room and a living room that opens onto a terrace; upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom, with a convertible attic above.
Outside are a shaded garden, a wooden terrace with open views and a 19th-century bread oven in its original state. Sold furnished if you wish.
paragraphs.gace-colombage-house-a39921: Inside are three bedrooms, a wood burner and a modern pellet burner, and a built-in cinema projector for a home cinema. Panoramic views over the countryside bring real calm. You can live in it straight away, or add living space with renovation.
paragraphs.la-roque-sur-ceze-village-house-a44763: The house is in the heart of a perched medieval village, with panoramic views over the village and the countryside. The village is known for its stone streets, river swimming, canoeing, hiking and forests. It suits a main home, a holiday home or a seasonal rental, with a wood burner and mains drainage. Bagnols-sur-Cèze is about 9 km away on the map, Orange 24 km, Avignon 39 km and Avignon airport 44 km.
paragraphs.riberac-stone-house-bvi77914:
Ribérac, five minutes away, has all amenities and a market every Friday. The house is attached to its neighbours but feels secluded, with parking for two or three cars. You can live in it straight away, with an oil boiler and radiators, or renovate it.
Two attached stone barns could be converted, with planning permission, and a separate workshop would suit a craftsman or an artist.
paragraphs.saint-sulpice-house-bvi80970:
The village has bakers, bars, restaurants, shops and an English-speaking doctor, and the A20 links to Paris, Limoges airport and the Channel ports. Inside are a tiled hallway, a dining kitchen, a sitting room with a marble fireplace and three bright bedrooms, one huge, with air-source central heating.
A large attic could become more rooms, with permission. Outside are a sheltered courtyard and a lawned garden next to the school's meadow. Furniture can be included, by negotiation.
paragraphs.chalais-stone-cottage-bvi86937: The property measures 87 m², with 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Listed features: stone, fireplace, original features, garden. Located in Chalais, Nouvelle-Aquitaine.
paragraphs.la-trimouille-house-bvi85550:
La Trimouille is a lively river village with a cinema, cafés, a restaurant, a shop and a pharmacy. The house was recently renovated, with a new fitted kitchen and shower room, mains sewer and fresh paint, and keeps its parquet floors, high ceilings and a chimney fire surround.
A bright living room opens onto a front balcony. There are a second room for a bedroom or an office and a bedroom, with a garage, laundry room and cellar below. The garden has an outbuilding and a small studio.
paragraphs.chateauponsac-stone-house-am5270:
In first-class condition, it is used as a holiday home and has been let as a gîte. Downstairs are an entrance hall with a laundry area, a storage cupboard, a separate toilet and an open-plan kitchen, dining room and lounge with a wood-burning stove; upstairs are three bedrooms and a family bathroom.
Outside are a sunny terrace, a garden with open views, partly fenced, a wild area that could be a vegetable garden or an orchard, and a large adjoining barn. It is sold partly furnished, with double glazing and electric heating. Bellac is about 17 km away on the map, Limoges 31 km and Limoges airport 31 km.
paragraphs.chamberet-stone-house-cc4941: The property measures 85 m², with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, on a plot of 1,835 m². Listed features: stone, fireplace, garden, garage, original features. Located in Chamberet, Nouvelle-Aquitaine.
paragraphs.valzergues-farmhouse-28262: The property measures 80 m², with 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, on a plot of 1,679 m². Listed features: stone, garden, outbuildings. Located in Valzergues, Occitanie.
paragraphs.lacourt-hamlet-house-32848: It is in the commune of Lacourt, between Saint-Girons and Oust, and needs no work. Semi-detached on one side, with an outbuilding: a living room with a kitchenette downstairs, two large bedrooms and a shower room upstairs, and a 28 m² attic that can be converted. A 20 m² terrace, and a separate 380 m² plot 30 m away.
paragraphs.ginals-watermill-32445: The property measures 75 m², with 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, on a plot of 11,000 m². Listed features: historic, original features. Located in Ginals, Occitanie.
paragraphs.millac-hamlet-house-bvi87682: The house is in excellent condition, with stone floors, wooden beams and a fireplace with a pellet burner. The plot has a barn with water and electricity that could become living space, with permission. L'Isle-Jourdain is 13 km away, Confolens 21 km and Limoges airport 61 km.
paragraphs.ladapeyre-modernised-house-a36890: The house is connected to mains drainage and has its own well. The village is rural and pretty, with an award-winning bakery and countryside all around. The lake at Châtelus-Malvaleix, with a bar and restaurant and a summer lifeguard, is 5 minutes by car. It suits a family home, with or without income from letting, or a low-upkeep holiday home.
paragraphs.siran-village-house-a42822:
Ready to move into, with an open ground floor of stone walls, a kitchen with an induction hob and an electric oven, a living and dining area and the terrace. Upstairs are two bright double bedrooms and a modern shower room; the basement room could be a bar, a games room or a hobby space.
Sold furnished. Shops and services are within 2 km, the airport within 50 km.
paragraphs.jumilhac-village-house-bvi85468: The house is at the edge of Jumilhac-le-Grand, with views from every window. The two double bedrooms have chimneys that could be reopened. There is a cave (a cellar), a large attic that could be converted with permission, a small back garden and parking off the street. Good condition, a short walk to the local shops.
paragraphs.avene-stone-house-a36741: Surrounded by countryside, it keeps much of its old character. Downstairs are a large living room with a wood burner, a fitted kitchen and a shower room; upstairs, three double bedrooms, a bathroom and a loft. Outside are a conservatory, a small paved garden and small cellars. The Avène thermal spa is a short drive away.
paragraphs.saint-laurent-de-ceris-farmhouse-bvi8441: At the edge of a Charente village, it keeps several original features: two double bedrooms, a sitting room with a kitchen, a dining room, a second reception room, two large lofts, a cellar and the barn. The garden wraps around the house. Confolens is nearby and Limoges airport about 40 minutes by car.
paragraphs.bouteilles-saint-sebastien-stone-house-a:
The hamlet is a short distance from the village of St Severin, with shops, bars, restaurants, a medical centre and a school. The ground floor has two bedrooms and a shower room; a stone spiral staircase leads up to a large open-plan kitchen, dining and living room with a chimney, and the third bedroom with its own shower room.
More stairs lead to a roof terrace, recently re-sealed and tiled, with views across the rolling countryside. There is a private parking space in front. Sold furnished.
paragraphs.lessac-hamlet-house-a48448: The hamlet is only 5 km from Confolens, a medieval town on the river with full amenities, and Limoges airport is 60 km away. The ground floor has an open-plan kitchen and living room, a dining room and a shower room; upstairs are two bedrooms and an office. The garden lies next to the house, and the house can be lived in as it is.
paragraphs.bonnefond-detached-house-a46567:
In the Parc naturel régional de Millevaches, the house has a powerful wood-burning stove in the living room, a fitted kitchen and a light-filled dining room looking onto the garden. Upstairs, the large main bedroom has its own bathroom, a walk-in wardrobe and countryside views.
The garden is over 800 m² with wide views over the Plateau de Millevaches, and the area is good for walks, cycling and fishing. The roof was replaced eight years ago. Also listed as suitable for a gîte.
paragraphs.charras-stone-village-house-a39270: The house is on three levels: a kitchen and dining room, a living room, a bedroom with its own bathroom, an office, a pantry and a boiler room. The two attached barns offer room for more living space. The garden next to the house looks over the countryside. In good condition.
